rv: A great film about manufacturing Wurlitzer jukeboxes

This 2 part film is a a great film about the manufacturing of jukeboxes with brief mentioning of their organs, pianos, and accordions they manufacture and actually provides you a tour of the Wurlitzer manufacturing plant from 1947 at the same time that they are actually manufacturing a quality jukebox. If you are nostalgic for the era of quality manufacturing, jukeboxes, record collectors, this is a must watch and BTW, Wurlitzer still makes organs as well as jukeboxes to this day, with today's jukeboxes actually being CD jukeboxes. BTW, jukebox play was what made recordings popular at the time

But definately for ME! The majority of this wonderful bit of industrial propaganda revolves around the process of the design and manufacture of the model 1100 juke box introduced in 1948. An amazing amount of footage of the plant and the workers as they create these wonderful machines. A lost art from a lost world, and a "must see" for anyone interested in the rich history of the Wurlitzer company, and the many decades of entertainment resulting from their products.
